content:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Streaming p99 latency > 10s for tenant BlueHarbor (dedicated). Instances: ded-us-west-2-7a. Trigger: p99_streaming_latency > SLO for 5m :rotating_light:

sam: oncall here, looking. Paging eng-sre and runtime. Can someone grab impact + mitigation?

rebecca: account reported 30+ user sessions seeing stalls, several timeouts from their frontend. They noticed it ~ 09:02 UTC.

anya: copy. are we sure it's single-tenant only? any cross-tenant signals?

darius: metrics show two clusters: tenant-specific pool is hot, host-wide infra looks normal. network and disk i/o OK.

darius: sharing a quick log excerpt (truncated):
```
[09:01:42] kvcache: evict_ratio=0.73, miss_rate=0.64, refill_latency_ms=12.4
[09:01:43] stream_worker: blocking_write_ms=2046, inflight=48
[09:01:44] runtime: session_id=bh-7a-xx, prompt_len=16784, token_inflight=1024
```

sam: prompt_len 16k? that's huge. BlueHarbor recently enabled a bulk-annotate feature that may send long batched contexts. @rebecca any changes on their side?

rebecca: they shipped a client change yesterday to send compressed + newline-delim JSON chunks. Ops said it was fine in staging.

ben: could be that long prefix is thrashing KV cache and streaming worker can't flush. p99 jumps when background eviction blocks the streaming path.

sam: steps please: 1) confirm incoming request sizes and rate 2) short-term mitigation (route/fallback) 3) deeper fix (rate-limit, request-size guard)

darius: running a quick histogram on request sizes: most under 2k but a small tail at ~16k-20k every 3-5s from BH tenant. That aligns.

sam: ok mitigation: can we divert BlueHarbor to a conservative model variant without streaming? fallback to rdm-compact-1 that handles long prefixes better (less KV pressure).

darius: routing command ready: `ops-route set --tenant blueharbor --model rdm-compact-1 --mode canary --weight 100`

sam: applying now.

pagerbot: action logged: ops-route applied by sam at 09:06 UTC (routes: blueharbor -> rdm-compact-1).

sam: monitoring. initial p99: 11.2s.

anya: have we considered disabling chunked flush for that tenant? it might trade latency for throughput but reduce blocking.

darius: yes, we can flip `streaming.flush_mode=buffered` on the tenant sidecar; command: `envset tenant/blueharbor streaming.flush_mode=buffered`

sam: doing that too.

pagerbot: config change queued by sam at 09:07 UTC.

sam: after route + flush_mode change p99 dropped to 1.8s at 09:09 UTC. customer reported resumed streams.

rebecca: told BlueHarbor we're mitigating and doing a root cause analysis. They're okay with temporary degraded streaming behavior but want a timeline.

ben: notes for RCA: long client prefixes + batching pattern -> KV cache thrash -> blocking writes in stream_worker -> cascading stall under high concurrency. Single-tenant pinned capacity meant load didn't spill.

anya: I'll take the on-call handoff for the night. summary for next oncall: impact, current mitigations, suggested follow-ups.

sam: handing off to @anya. key actions to track: 1) keep blueharbor routed to rdm-compact-1 until guardrails 2) add tenant-level request-size limit to ingress 3) add KV cache eviction backpressure metrics and alarm when evict_ratio > 0.6 4) temp: increase dedicated pool concurrency for BH by +20% if we see repeat spike.

anya: got it. I'll coordinate with runtime to schedule a canary change for request-size limit and add a Grafana panel for eviction_ratio alert.

darius: will open a runtime ticket with logs and suggested fixes: protect KV cache with per-tenant soft limit and throttle long-prefix clients earlier in the pipeline.

rebecca: I'll sync with BlueHarbor PM and Ops to ensure they roll out a client fix to chunk/summarize before send.

sam: nice fast mitigation. sending post-incident note to #postmortems and scheduling 1h RCA with runtime + eng-sre + customer success tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged, severity: sev2, ticket: INC-2026-784 (created 09:12 UTC).

anya: handover done. I have escalation contact for BH: ops@blueharbor.com. Leaving a short playbook in the ticket.

rebecca: thanks team. I'll update the customer and add a sticky note to their account so future routing decisions consider large-batch patterns. :white_check_mark:

sam: resolving page. if anything resurfaces ping @oncall.

ben: follow-ups tracked: RFC for request-size guardrails, KV-cache instrumentation, improved tenant throttles.

anya: adding me as owner for the follow-ups in the ticket. closing thread here, will post RCA link when ready.
_meta: generated for dataset: realistic slack thread about an incident - single-tenant long-prefix streaming stalls
